legend: Recently Maxim has found an array of n integers, needed by no one. He immediately come up with idea of changing it: he invented positive integer x and decided to add or subtract it from arbitrary array elements. Formally, by applying single operation Maxim chooses integer i (1 ≤ i ≤ n) and replaces the i-th element of array ai either with ai + x or with ai - x. Please note that the operation may be applied more than once to the same position.

Maxim is a curious minimalis, thus he wants to know what is the minimum value that the product of all array elements (i.e. ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2f9309f35d7faa3a510387f08ee16afbd2ef1d2a.png)) can reach, if Maxim would apply no more than k operations to it. Please help him in that.
input: The first line of the input contains three integers n, k and x (1 ≤ n, k ≤ 200 000, 1 ≤ x ≤ 109) — the number of elements in the array, the maximum number of operations and the number invented by Maxim, respectively.
The second line contains n integers a1, a2, ..., an (![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9a8b1c66df023fb7075ec9dba75e73a53f173334.png)) — the elements of the array found by Maxim.
output: Print n integers b1, b2, ..., bn in the only line — the array elements after applying no more than k operations to the array. In particular, ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/25a4bad1de460e01b26a65b4e7c0cc0680b347dd.png) should stay true for every 1 ≤ i ≤ n, but the product of all array elements should be minimum possible.
If there are multiple answers, print any of them.

legend.ai: 最近，Maxim 找到了一个无人需要的 n 个整数数组。他立即想出了修改它的主意：他发明了一个正整数 x，并决定对任意数组元素加上或减去 x。形式化地说，在一次操作中，Maxim 选择一个整数 i（1 ≤ i ≤ n），并将数组的第 i 个元素 ai 替换为 ai + x 或 ai - x。请注意，同一个位置可以被操作多次。
Maxim 是一个好奇的极简主义者，因此他想知道，如果对数组进行不超过 k 次操作，所有数组元素的乘积(即 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2f9309f35d7faa3a510387f08ee16afbd2ef1d2a.png))能够达到的最小值是多少。请帮助他解决这个问题。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含三个整数 n、k 和 x（1 ≤ n，k ≤ 200 000，1 ≤ x ≤ 109），分别表示数组中元素的个数、操作次数上限以及 Maxim 发明的数值。
第二行包含 n 个整数 a1、a2、...、an(![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9a8b1c66df023fb7075ec9dba75e73a53f173334.png))，表示 Maxim 找到的数组中的元素。

output.ai: 在唯一一行中输出 n 个整数 b1, b2, ..., bn——对数组进行不超过 k 次操作后的数组元素。特别地，对于每个 1 ≤ i ≤ n，![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/25a4bad1de460e01b26a65b4e7c0cc0680b347dd.png) 都应保持为真，但所有数组元素的乘积应尽可能小。
如果有多个答案，输出任意一个。
